Nyeeeh... What a pain...
This is the biggest pain ever...

That's a pain, too...
Why do I need to spend time with you?

Well...if you're just going to sit there, 
I don't mind...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Himiko, who was
spacing out.
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I grew a little closer today.
